app.name: Motion Highlighter
main.title: Motion Highlighter
main.no_video: No video loaded. Click 'Open Video...' or 'Open Stream...' to begin.
main.tooltip_open_video: Open a local video file (MP4, AVI, MKV, MOV, WMV, etc.)
main.tooltip_open_stream: Connect to a live streaming source (DASH, HLS, Fragmented MP4, MJPEG, RTSP)
main.tooltip_about: About Motion Highlighter: Application details, Generated Pixel links, and LGBTQ+ Pride community info.
main.tooltip_screenshot: Capture Screenshot (Shortcut: S): Save the current frame with motion overlays as a PNG or JPEG.
main.tooltip_zoom_in: Zoom In (Ctrl + Plus / Wheel Up): Zoom in to inspect motion highlights and bounding boxes in fine detail.
main.tooltip_zoom_out: Zoom Out (Ctrl + Minus / Wheel Down): Zoom out to get a wider perspective.
main.tooltip_zoom_reset: Fit to Window (Shortcut: Escape / Ctrl + 0 / Double-Click): Resets zoom to fit entire video.
main.tooltip_zoom_level: Current Zoom Level (100% - 1000%): Click and drag on video to pan.
main.tooltip_play: Play / Pause (Shortcut: Spacebar): Toggle video playback or live stream monitoring.
main.tooltip_step_back: Step Backward (Shortcut: Left Arrow): Move back one frame (local video only).
main.tooltip_step_forward: Step Forward (Shortcut: Right Arrow): Move forward one frame (local video only).
main.tooltip_threshold: Pixel difference threshold for motion sensitivity.
main.tooltip_blur: Gaussian blur kernel size to suppress sensor noise.
main.tooltip_min_area: Minimum pixel area required to classify a motion region.
main.tooltip_max_area: Maximum pixel area threshold to discard broad ambient lighting changes.
main.tooltip_learn_rate: Speed at which the background accumulation model updates (0 = static).
main.tooltip_box_hold: Number of frames to keep bounding boxes visible after motion stops.
main.tooltip_chk_overlay: Show or hide highlighted motion trails overlay.
main.tooltip_chk_trails: Include historical motion trails in the overlay display.
main.tooltip_chk_boxes: Show or hide dynamic bounding boxes around moving targets.
main.tooltip_alpha: Opacity percentage of the motion overlay.
main.tooltip_export: Export highlighted video with bounding boxes and overlays to MP4.
main.tooltip_cancel_export: Cancel the ongoing video export process.
main.msg_no_frame_screenshot: No active frame available to capture screenshot.
about.title: About Motion Highlighter
about.heading: Motion Highlighter
about.description:
Real-time motion highlighting, object tracking, interactive video zoom, and MP4 video export for security cameras, local video files, and live streaming sources (DASH, HLS, Fragmented MP4, MJPEG, RTSP).

Crafted with care by the team at Generated Pixel.
about.pride_statement: 💖 Celebrating diversity, equality, and LGBTQ+ pride in open source technology. All creators, developers, and users are welcome here.
